notes.title: LYSFANGA: THE TIME SHIFT WARRIOR - FREE UPDATE
notes.content:
We are happy to share that Lysfanga: The Time Shift Warrior got a new update that brings a much-awaited feature and many quality-of-life improvements. 

[h2]ONLINE LEADERBOARD
[/h2]
In this update, you will have access to two leaderboards for the Story Arenas as well as Figments of Battle challenges.  

Compare your scores with your friends and the best players from around the world! 

[h2]WARRIOR CHALLENGES[/h2]

We are bringing a new time challenge to the Story Arenas! 

Once you beat the standard time challenge in an arena, you will unlock “Warrior Challenges”, a.k.a. the times set by the developers themselves! 

Do your best and try to beat us! 

[h2]RAZER CHROMA INTEGRATION
[/h2]
We are also adding Razer Chroma RGB™ integration to the game! 

If you have a compatible device, you will have access to new RGB effects that will enhance your experience while playing the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2161620/Lysfanga_The_Time_Shift_Warrior/

notes.title: Lysfanga : The Time Shift Warrior Patch note 1.02.001
notes.content:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Quality of Life: You can now switch weapons while in Overview mode.
    [*]HUD: The currently equipped rune is now displayed in the bottom-left.
    [*]HUD: Added a slight background to improve remnant count readability.
    [*]UI: Default cursor has been updated to be more visible.
    [*]UI: Tutorials videos have been updated.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Orb of Light damage slightly increased.
    [*]Flood of Light damage increased.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused the game to get stuck in the 4th boss' phase 4.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue causing Bombwings to sometimes be stuck in mid-air.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused some Figments of Battle levels with the “Lightning Fast” challenge to not start properly in Simplified Chinese.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused the echoes triggered by Paroxysm to incorrectly be blocked by Guardians, causing an additional issue in a related Figments of Battle challenge.
    [*]Gameplay: Binary Doors and Magical Doors no longer destroy thrown projectiles on contact.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed an issue that caused some colliders to destroy thrown projectiles on contact.
    [*]Gameplay: Rune of Weapon Mastery now deals more consistent damage to enemies.
    [*]Gameplay: Rune of Crystalline Massacre now deals more consistent damage to enemies.
    [*]Gameplay: Some Magical Doors now open more quickly.
    [*]Gameplay: Fixed several collision issues.
    [*]Text: Fixed typos in various languages.
    [*]Graphics: Fixed issues related to some spells VFX.
    [*]Graphics: Fixed Glaring Light VFX not replaying correctly upon second use.
[/list]
